{{Quote|My younger sister joined a religious sect on Devon Four. When they refused to pay taxes Coruscant slapped an embargo on them. When a plague struck the colony, they were going to die, every woman, man, and child. No one would do a thing.|Sheeka Tull|<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />}}
'''Sheeka Tull's sister''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Along with their elder sister, [[Sheeka Tull]], they were orphaned during a range war on the astronomical object [[Atrivis 7]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Tull's sister later joined a religious sect on [[Devon Four]] but, when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was embargoed for not paying taxes, almost [[Death/Legends|died]] from a plague at the colony until Tull [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] in medical supplies. Following that incident, the woman moved to a new home and raised a family.

==Biography==
{{Quote|So you got them their medicine.|[[Jangotat|Alpha-98]] to Sheeka Tull, on her sister's sect|<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who grew up in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was the daughter of [[Sheevis Tull]] and younger sister of [[Sheeka Tull]]. Sheeka and her sister were orphaned during a range war on [[Atrivis 7]], an astronomical object<ref name="The Cestus Deception" /> in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]]</ref> The sisters later separated when the younger joined a religious sect on [[Devon Four]],<ref name="The Cestus Deception" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose government ceased paying taxes to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was consequently placed under an embargo several years before the Clone Wars.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|187|Devon Four}}</ref>

That almost destroyed the colony when a plague struck the planet; the inability to import medicines from off-world threatened to result in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of every sect member, including Sheeka's sister. That fate was only averted when Sheeka [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] medicine onto the planet. Following that incident, Sheeka's sister left the sect and moved elsewhere in the Outer Rim, eventually raising a family with several children.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|And your sister?''"<br />"''Raising a squalling brood of brats somewhere in the Outer Rim. I'd do it all over again.|Alpha-98 and Sheeka Tull|<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />}}
The woman was religious, as evidenced by their joining a sect on Devon Four. They had strong ties with Sheeka, who broke the law in order to save her sister's life; despite the smuggling later exposing her to danger in the lead up to the Clone Wars, Sheeka never regretted saving her sister.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sheeka Tull's sister was mentioned in [[Steven Barnes]]'s [[2004]] novel ''[[The Cestus Deception]]''.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />
